findings.highlight: With Saber in that outfit, I can't help but actually think she's real now.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの服装はあまりにも現実感がありすぎて、否応なしに異性を意識してしまうのだ。
findings.governingReading: Normal, concrete clothing makes him inevitably conscious of her as a woman.
findings.explanation: Awareness of the opposite sex becomes awareness she is real.

findings.highlight: Each of us made a name for ourselves in our respective time periods; we accomplished some great deed beyond human capabilities.
findings.evidenceJa: それぞれが“自分の生きた時代”で名を馳せたか、或いは人の身に余る偉業を成し遂げた者たち。
findings.governingReading: They either won renown in their era or accomplished a deed beyond human capability.
findings.explanation: Fame or extraordinary achievement becomes fame plus extraordinary achievement.

findings.highlight: Whatever the means, we are beings who have sublimated to deity-esque status."
findings.evidenceJa: どのような手段であれ、一個人の力だけで神域まで上り詰めた存在です」
findings.governingReading: Whatever the means, one individual’s power alone carried them to the divine realm.
findings.explanation: Individual power alone disappears from divine-level attainment.

findings.highlight: "That is correct. First of all, summoning a Heroic Spirit is itself close to a miracle. To summon seven of them is too much even for the Holy Grail.
findings.evidenceJa: 「そうです。もとより英霊をまるごと召喚する、という事自体が奇蹟に近い。それを七人分、というのは聖杯でも手に余る。
findings.governingReading: The near-miracle is summoning the entire Heroic Spirit; prepared class vessels resolve the sevenfold burden.
findings.explanation: Summoning a whole Heroic Spirit loses whole.

findings.highlight: "Correct. There may be some Heroic Spirits who possess multiple attributes, but I would say in all humility that there are none better than I with the sword."
findings.evidenceJa: 「はい。属性を複数持つ英霊もいますが、こと剣に関しては私の右に出る者はいない、と自負しています」
findings.governingReading: She prides herself on having no superior with the sword.
findings.explanation: Pride in unequaled swordsmanship becomes saying it in all humility.

findings.highlight: If you can't beat your opponent with a sword, you just have to come up with another way.
findings.evidenceJa: 剣で敵わない相手なら、剣以外で敵の息の根を絶つだけの話じゃないか。
findings.governingReading: If the sword cannot beat the foe, another method ends the foe’s life.
findings.explanation: Killing by another means becomes coming up with another way.

findings.highlight: "That is correct. If your opponent discovers that you are skilled in close combat, then they will most likely not challenge you thusly. In that sense, Servants who lack ability will use any means possible."
findings.evidenceJa: 「そういう事です。白兵戦で優れている、と相手に知られた場合、相手はまず白兵戦など仕掛けてこないでしょう。……そういった意味で言うと、能力に劣ったサーヴァントはあらゆる手を尽くしてくる」
findings.governingReading: An enemy aware of being outclassed will not initiate close combat.
findings.explanation: Knowing you are superior in close combat becomes knowing you are skilled.

findings.highlight: It sucked up all the magical energy in the air and stabbed Saber's chest with an impossible trajectory.
findings.evidenceJa: 大気中の魔力を吸い上げ、あり得ない軌跡でセイバーの胸を貫いたあの槍。
findings.governingReading: The spear draws magical energy from the air before its impossible trajectory.

findings.highlight: Lancer's spear certainly seemed like something with history, but the spear itself was not extraordinary.
findings.evidenceJa: たしかにランサーの槍は曰くありげな槍だったけど、それ自体は槍っていう領域から出てなかっただろ。
findings.governingReading: The storied and cursed artifact was still within the spear domain before the words made it exceed weapons.
findings.explanation: Remaining within the category of a spear becomes not extraordinary.

findings.highlight: You need to understand the situation we're in to make decisions about our next steps."
findings.evidenceJa: 状況が判ったのなら、これからどうするかを決めるべきではないですか」
findings.governingReading: After he says the explanation makes sense, she asks what he will do now that he understands and leans in to demand an answer.
findings.explanation: Having understood and now choosing becomes needing understanding before choosing.
